title: SAP FICO Consultant
summary: An SAP FICO consultant sets up the finance (FI) and controlling (CO) parts of SAP so that a company's accounts, costs and reports run correctly inside the system. They sit between the finance team and the technical team, turning accounting needs into SAP settings and into written specs that ABAP developers build from.
dailyDuties: Configure ledgers, payables, receivables and asset accounting in SAP
Run workshops with finance users to capture requirements
Write functional specs for reports, interfaces and forms for ABAP developers
Test configuration and support users during acceptance testing
Support month-end close and fix finance tickets
Prepare data migration templates and cutover steps

skills.expectation: Configure general ledger, payables, receivables, asset and bank accounting in S/4HANA
Configure cost centres, profit centres, internal orders and product costing
Understand accounting entries, month-end close and financial statements
Gather finance requirements and write functional specs for ABAP developers
Map current and future finance processes during blueprint workshops
Write test scripts and run integration and user acceptance testing with finance users
Run workshops and train finance users in plain language
Configure Indian GST and withholding tax in SAP
Debug ABAP and review custom code with the technical team
Specify IDocs and BAPIs for bank and third-party interfaces
Resolve finance tickets within SLAs on support projects
Prepare data migration templates and reconciliations

certifications.why: The standard SAP FI certification that FICO postings ask for.
Proves the Controlling half of a FICO consultant's work.
